units.source_text: 这天名人是同业余棋手练习，不怎么引人注目。

en.t: That day, the Master was practicing with an amateur player, so it did not attract much attention.

units.source_text: 可他还是很快就沉湎在忘我的境界之中。

en.t: But even so, he soon sank into a state of self-forgetful absorption.

units.source_text: 到了要去海滨饭店吃晚饭时，第二盘以黑130结束。

en.t: When it was time to go to the Seaside Hotel for dinner, the second game ended at Black's 130th move.

units.source_text: 这是以很强的业余初段为对手的，胜了四目。

en.t: His opponent was a very strong amateur first dan, and he won by four points.

units.source_text: 黑子的棋风是从中盘出力，

en.t: Black's style was to exert his strength from the middle game onward,
and this game developed into a position that broke up White's framework,
